data.description:
## Discovered from
bug `conversant-cepivorous-mastiff` (0449-cf75-bb4b-41fd), which widened `claim` to accept a `blocked` source status.

## Problem
`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/claimability.py` lists `blocked` in `_NOT_CLAIMABLE_STATUSES`, so `review-plan` on a blocked ticket fast-fails INDETERMINATE with the reason 'not claimable: status is "blocked", not "open"'. That premise is now false: `claim` accepts `blocked`.

Residual gap: a gated `task`/`story`/`epic` sitting in `blocked` with a MISSING or STALE plan-review attestation cannot earn a fresh one — `claim` refuses on the gate, and `review-plan` refuses to run. `--force` is the only lever.

## Why it was NOT fixed under the parent bug
The blocked fast-fail is **documented intended behavior** in three places — `AGENTS.md` L129, `docs/user-guide.md` L338, `docs/workflow-engine.md` L34-35 — so changing it is a plan-review gate design decision with a doc-contract change, not a defect repair.

## Scope if taken
Remove `blocked` from `_NOT_CLAIMABLE_STATUSES`, correct the reason string (it asserts 'not open'), and update the three docs. Keep `closed`/`idea` fast-failing.
data.title: review-plan fast-fails on blocked, so a resumable blocked ticket cannot refresh a stale claim attestation
